purpose: Compare roster identity effects against aggregate player features, not promise higher future accuracy.

source_truth.training_rosters: previous-calendar projected selectors, not verified actual announced lineups

hypothesis: Roster identity effects and direct outcome modeling may retain information lost by pooled AB/H/BB and ERA averages. Falsifiable, not a new academic invention.

M0_reference.family: same aggregate-player independent Poisson reference refit

M1_roster_poisson.family: penalized hitter and opposing starter identity effects added to reference log-run means
M1_roster_poisson.batting_weights: ORDER_PA 4.7,4.6,4.5,4.4,4.3,4.2,4.1,4.0,3.9 divided by their mean; fixed, no search
M1_roster_poisson.effects: own nine hitter effects plus opposing starter effect, distinct roles; no target outcome/statistics

M2_roster_outcome.family: ridge three-category multinomial logistic using same past scalar features, home-away weighted hitter exposure and home-away starter exposure
M2_roster_outcome.draw: explicit draw category; no arbitrary probability threshold
M2_roster_outcome.team_identity: home-minus-away team categorical exposures, train-only vocabulary, base L2=10
M2_roster_outcome.batting_weights: same fixed ORDER_PA weights as M1, normalized to mean one

fit_rules.player_vocabulary: fit partition only; new hitter/starter IDs neutral role effect, with explicit missing/unknown indicators; do not drop matches
fit_rules.numeric_transform: fit partition only, train mean plus missing indicator; observed zero distinct from null
fit_rules.identity_exposure: fixed role-specific sparse design, no seasonal end-statistics
fit_rules.player_effect_interpretation: predictive associations confounded with team/usage, not causal player value
fit_rules.optimizer: bounded deterministic numerical convergence checks; stop/report failures, no silent fallbacks

temporal_protocol.inner_validation: 2024 with seven calendar days before boundary embargo
temporal_protocol.inner_selection: select each M1/M2 player L2 by 3-way outcome log loss; ties within 1e-12 prefer stronger shrinkage
temporal_protocol.outer_validation: 2025 with seven calendar days before boundary embargo
temporal_protocol.family_selection: 2025 3-way log loss, then Brier within 1e-12, then M0/M1/M2 complexity order; freeze before scoring 2026
temporal_protocol.2026: retrospective reused diagnostic only, no selection/tuning by 2026 outcomes
temporal_protocol.rolling_features: previous calendar dates only even when weights frozen; same-date doubleheaders cannot see one another

evaluation.primary_roster_scenario: fresh projected target 709, identical fixture set as preceding study
evaluation.secondary_roster_scenario: fresh official batting and starter 709, no family reselection
evaluation.prices: same original frozen price ledgers from b160d3d1; strict and extended separated; no new price optimization
evaluation.old_frozen_reference: report preceding 398/403 and ROI -9.625/-8.262 as labeled fixed old baseline; not equivalent to newly refitted M0
metrics: Decimal flat-unit ROI with draw refunds in stake denominator
known-player substitution counterfactuals and role effects
evaluation.price_current_reject_sensitivity: exclude same seven nonzero current buyReject records for every model; do not assert historical sellability
evaluation.multiple_comparisons: two challenger families with preregistered finite penalties; no winner promotion from retrospective diagnostics

required_tests: role distinction and player substitution sensitivity
unknown neutral players no dropped fixture
Poisson and softmax probability mass and finite tails
byte-stable persisted contracts and predictions across CRLF modes
future_evaluation: Any genuinely prospective future schedule must preserve actual received source and price snapshots before kickoff. No automatic production or schedule changes in this task.
out_of_scope: Markov baserunner model until detailed transition inputs and approximations are separately agreed
pitcher handedness/platoon absent from current raw fields
actual service 9:1 or actual tipster replay without matched frozen predictions
wallet replay or monthly ledger change

sources.use: Yang and Swartz 2004 motivate distinct team, batting and starting-pitcher contributions; this is not exact reproduction
Uehara et al. 2022 latent-class/base-out model needs richer transitions; not implemented or claimed as profit evidence
existing player shrinkage/order-weighted experiment is prior work, not new discovery
existing team outcome/state models lack direct full-roster identity input; distinguish extension from new invention
